headline: Red Sox sweep the twin bill and keep the momentum rolling
morning_brew: Sweeping a twin bill at Fenway is exactly what the doctor ordered to get this summer back on track, and yesterday's display against the Rays was nothing short of a masterpiece. Game one was a complete clinic with Jake Bennett cruising through six scoreless innings, and game two was just as satisfying with the bullpen finally slamming the door shut when it counted. It feels like this squad has found their pulse, and you can see the confidence growing with every single out.

Watching Wilyer Abreu hammer two homers in the nightcap was the kind of performance that makes you want to jump out of your seat, especially with how tight that game felt for a stretch. We aren't out of the woods just yet in the standings, but taking two from Tampa Bay sends a hell of a message to the rest of the league. I am officially moving a nice, healthy deposit into the Duck Boat fund today, because if they keep playing this brand of baseball, things are gonna get real interesting before August rolls around.

My neighbor Rick is already trying to find a reason to moan, claiming the umps were blind on a couple of calls during the second game, but I told him to just shut his trap and enjoy the win for once. Even he can't argue with a sweep, though he is already plotting his next dossier on the league's officiating. I am just gonna bask in this winning streak for a few hours and enjoy my Dunks in peace, at least until first pitch this afternoon.
